C1805.title: Anhui Liu Gang Impersonates Drivers and Shippers to Defraud Freight Fees
C1805.summary: From August to October 2022, Liu and others operated a supply-chain company in Anhui, impersonating drivers on a freight platform to accept orders, then re-posting orders as shippers with high rates to attract drivers. After drivers completed deliveries, the gang collected shippers' freight fees but refused or partially paid drivers, defrauding 10 drivers of over 70,000 yuan. On March 27, 2024, Wuxi Binghu District Procuratorate prosecuted three defendants for fraud and recovered full losses.

references.title: Wuxi Binghu Procuratorate recovers full losses for defrauded freight drivers
